title: Spymaster clue + team guess flow
sub_tasks: GIVE_CLUE handler: spymaster sends word + number, validate single word + no grid match
GUESS_CARD handler: team member taps card, reveal color, check result
Turn logic: correct guess = continue (up to number+1), neutral/opponent = end turn
END_TURN handler: team voluntarily ends guessing phase
acceptance: Only guessers on active team can guess
Turn switches to other team after end
